security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown links, tables, Mermaid diagrams, and inline code formatting. The real concern is the crawler helper that accepts a user-provided URL without documented safety controls. No prompt-injection language was found.

remediation.issue: Crawler helper accepts arbitrary URL input
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user permission, validate URLs, block localhost and private IP ranges, quote arguments, and set crawl limits before running crawl.py.

remediation.issue: External helper commands are shown as shell snippets
remediation.suggestion: Prefer structured tool calls, or state that URLs must be passed as one argument and never interpolated into a shell command.

remediation.issue: Parent-directory documentation links trigger path traversal alarms
remediation.suggestion: Package referenced documentation with the skill, or replace ../../../ links with marketplace-safe reference names.

content.user_title: Optimize Website Structure and Internal Links
content.value_statement: Complex sites often bury important pages and weaken search signals. This skill designs hierarchy, URL taxonomy, navigation, topic clusters, and internal link fixes with scored priorities.
actual_capabilities: Chooses architecture or linking mode from the user request.
Builds site hierarchy, URL taxonomy, navigation, and hub-spoke topic clusters.
Reviews internal link graphs for orphans, click depth, anchor mix, and authority flow.
Creates prioritized source, target, and anchor plans for internal links.
Produces Mermaid sitemap guidance and a structure score.
Labels metrics as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
limitations: It does not analyze external backlinks.
It does not diagnose XML sitemap or indexation issues.
It does not compute the CORE-EEAT gate score.
It needs a domain, sitemap, crawl export, or page inventory for reliable results.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Site Architecture
use_cases.description: Create a clear page hierarchy, URL taxonomy, navigation model, and topic cluster plan before launch.

use_cases.title: Fix Internal Link Gaps
use_cases.description: Find orphan pages, deep pages, weak anchor text, and missing contextual links across an existing site.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Restructure Handoff
use_cases.description: Turn a messy page inventory into priorities, redirect needs, and a handoff summary for implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the site structure for a new [site type] website. Goals are [goals]. Include hierarchy, URL taxonomy, navigation, and a score.

prompt_templates.title: Review Page Inventory
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page list for [domain]. Find orphan pages and pages deeper than three clicks. Give prioritized internal link fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Topic Clusters
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a hub and spoke model for [topic]. Map pillars, spokes, cross-links, anchor guidance, and sitemap recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Crawl Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this crawl export and analytics summary for [domain]. Compare structure to the best model. Provide redirects, priorities, and handoff risks.

output_examples.input: A SaaS team needs a new marketing site for features, pricing, use cases, and a blog.
output_examples.output: A two-level navigation plan, URL map, hub-spoke content plan, Mermaid sitemap guidance, and architecture score.

output_examples.input: A blog has one pillar post and five related posts, but several pages have no inbound links.
output: An orphan list with keep, redirect, or noindex recommendations.
A source, target, and anchor plan for new contextual links.
A revised structure score and follow-up tracking plan.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce category tree has deep product pages and mixed URL patterns.
output_examples.output: A depth diagnosis, URL cleanup plan, navigation changes, redirect cautions, and implementation priorities.

best_practices: Provide a sitemap, crawl export, or page inventory before asking for a score.
Mark analytics, crawler data, and inferred metrics clearly in the request.
Review redirect and noindex recommendations before publishing structural changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for external backlink analysis.
Do not ask it to invent measured crawl metrics without data.
Do not migrate URLs without a redirect plan and target validation.

faq.question: Does this skill crawl a site by itself?
faq.answer: It can use connected crawler data or a user-provided page list. Live crawling should require permission and safe URL limits.

faq.question: Can it analyze backlinks?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on internal structure, internal links, URLs, navigation, and topic clusters.

faq.question: Can it generate XML sitemaps?
faq.answer: No. It may design a visual site map, but XML sitemap and indexation work belongs to technical SEO tooling.

faq.question: What inputs give the best results?
faq.answer: Use a domain, sitemap, crawl export, page inventory, key goals, and important pages to preserve.

faq.question: Does it produce a score?
faq.answer: Yes. It produces an architecture or structure score based on orphans, depth, URL risks, and link distribution.

faq.question: Can it work without analytics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can work from a page list, but it must label missing metrics as estimated or not available.
